title: Removing the defender
summary: Capture the piece that holds everything together.

steps.text: Sometimes a target is defended by just one piece. Capture or chase away that defender and the target falls. Always ask: *what is this piece protecting?*

steps.prompt: Black’s rook is the only guard of the back rank. Take it - with check.
steps.success: Rxd8# - with its only defender gone, the back rank collapses at once.
